title: 2020 roadmap on pore materials for energy and environmental applications
claim: Matching MOF energy levels with a semiconductor and creating close interfacial contact can facilitate photogenerated charge separation and transfer.
explanation: The review proposes MOFs as charge-transfer mediators in heterojunctions and contrasts close, potentially covalent contact with simple physical adsorption.
conditions: MOF orbital levels and semiconductor levels must be suitably aligned.
caveats: The benefit depends on the particular interface and is presented as a design principle rather than a quantified universal effect.
